clauses.name: Traumatize
clauses.printedParagraph: Lose 5 points, then a target player shows you their hand. Choose a card inside it, that player discards that card.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Pay the printed essence cost at declaration, then lose five points when resolving. Show the chosen player’s hand and discard exactly the selected instance, respecting hand immunity and movement replacements. Empty/immune hands do not skip the five-point loss. Validate responses atomically; keep hand information private to the involved players and privileged observers.

clauses.name: Extortionist Womb
clauses.printedParagraph: After the Revelation, a target opponent can show you their hand. If they do, choose a manifestation inside it, the opponent Chains that manifestation. If the opponent does not show you their hand or if they cannot Chain, put 2 tokens with 2 power {H} in Support.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Trigger as a normal Stack effect at Reaction after Revelation. The opponent may refuse; refusal or inability to Chain creates two hollow power-two Support tokens. If they accept, show their entire non-immune hand privately and let the effect controller choose a legal Manifestation for the opponent to Chain. Preserve selected instances, fallback conditions and the effect after source departure.
